notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Sorry for the last update could not enter the worlds, Unfortunately, we have noticed that only now!

The bug has now been fixed! 

We will release a big update in january for Relax Walk VR with more Maps and Interaction.

notes.title: Little patch for Achievements Hunter without VR Headset
notes.notes:
Many users have asked me whether it is possible to unlock the Achievements without a VR Headset!

To Unlock all Achievements without VR Headset Start Game and wait 5 Minutes thats all :)

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
First Patch for Relax Walk.

 Whats New?

    Add YouTube Browser.
    The game now has 2 locomotion Types. Teleportation and Direct Move.

If you find bugs you can report it here.
